ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/cls.zh: YOLO26 Cls 采用卷积特征提取与池化分类头，将整幅图像映射为类别分数，并通过概率排序输出分类结果。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/cls.en: YOLO26 Cls uses convolutional feature extraction and a pooling classification head to map the full image to class scores, then ranks the results by probability.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/seg.zh: YOLO26 Seg 结合直接 LTRB 回归、掩码原型与实例系数，在预测目标类别和边框的同时生成各实例的像素级分割掩码。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/seg.en: YOLO26 Seg combines direct LTRB regression with mask prototypes and instance coefficients to predict object classes and boxes while generating a pixel-level segmentation mask for each instance.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/pose.zh: YOLO26 Pose 在多尺度特征图上联合预测人体边框与 17 个关键点，通过坐标解码和置信度筛选输出人体姿态。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/pose.en: YOLO26 Pose jointly predicts human bounding boxes and 17 keypoints across multi-scale feature maps, then decodes coordinates and filters by confidence to output human poses.

ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/obb.zh: YOLO26 OBB 采用直接 LTRB 回归与角度预测分支，在多尺度特征图上联合预测类别、位置与方向，输出贴合目标朝向的旋转框。
ultralytics_yolo/yolo26/obb.en: YOLO26 OBB uses direct LTRB regression and an angle prediction branch to jointly predict classes, positions, and orientations across multi-scale feature maps, producing rotated boxes aligned with each object's orientation.
